title: Repeated coordinate updates are overwritten
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\eta$ assign one of the three restriction states to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $L$ be a list of distinct coordinates, and let $x,y\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$. Applying the updates prescribed by $x$ on $L$, followed by those prescribed by $y$ on $L$, has the same result as applying only the updates prescribed by $y$ on $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $\eta$ is a restriction assignment on $n$ coordinates
$L$ is a list of coordinates with no repetitions
